description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49), not yet finalized. How Result.verdict relates to Validation Rule 6. Rule 6 already says a GraderResult with score: null means 'not verified' for that one grader. verdict lifts the same idea to the whole Result. Here the only grader is an llm_judge whose output could not be parsed (the same shape as null_score_not_scored_failure.json), so no grader established anything, and verdict: "unverified" is the RECOMMENDED (not required) value. The two are not redundant: a Result can be unverified with every grader scored (see verdict_unverified_worker_left_unknown_valid.json), and a producer may leave verdict absent here, in which case consumers apply Rule 6 exactly as before. A conforming validator MUST ACCEPT this document.
